messages:
Maria: Quick alert 1 ZephyrWorks account — renewal in ~6w, but calls are down sharply. Seats active down ~70% this fortnight, main traffic drop on generate+embeds. Procurement asked for competitor benchmark. Need triage + retention play.
Alex: Understood. Is this across environments or only production?
Maria: Prod only. I ran a quick route break: 
```sql
select route, count(*) from api_events where cust='zephyr_123' and ts > now() - interval '14 days' group by 1 order by 2 desc;
```
Top two are /v1/generate and /v1/embeds.
Emma: Looping in PS 0 @Tess can you run a focused enablement session? they mentioned trouble sharding embed indexes.
Tess: Yep. I can do a 30-45m call Thu 10am PT. I'll ship a one-pager covering batching, sharding, cache hints.
Raj: They flagged CloudFox POC pushing cheaper embedding ops. I'll draft procurement note comparing latency/cost and propose a short Dedicated trial vs discount.
Darren: If both embed+generate are affected, suspect KV cache churn after their ingest spike. Share a couple request ids and tiny logs and I'll correlate pod-side.
Maria: Two sample reqs: zfw-req-7712, zfw-req-7729. Snip: 
[2026-03-22T14:12:03Z] zfw-req-7712 route=/v1/embeds latency=1320ms status=200 kv_cache_hit=false
[2026-03-22T14:12:08Z] zfw-req-7729 route=/v1/generate latency=1580ms status=200 kv_cache_hit=false
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-22_14:00 -> prod succeeded :white_check_mark:
Alex: Proposed quick play: 1) Tess enablement Thu 10am PT 2) Darren to triage cache/eviction + kernel logs 3) Raj to prepare procurement brief + trial ask 4) Emma to set weekly QBR cadence until renewal 5) Maria to own tracker and exec ping if no re-engagement.
Emma: Sending the invite now and adding architecture + cost comparisons. :calendar:
Raj: I'll cc finance and recommend a 30-day Dedicated trial credit if we see infra-related latency.
Darren: Tracing the req IDs now, checking cache hit ratios and pod restarts. ETA EOD.
Maria: Great. Also adding a short customer-facing note offering hands-on help with embed sharding so they don't feel pushed to the competitor.
Tess: I'll attach the deck + quick code snippets to the invite.
Emma: Quick ops note 1 CS Ops can approve up to 1 week of Dedicated credits; beyond that needs finance approval. I'll confirm exact amounts in the invite thread.
Maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after Darren's findings and post-enablement to decide trial credit amount.
